findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The wasn’t any hand soap in the women’s restroom at the start of the inspection. Discussed with PIC and hand soap was provided. Ensure that hand soap is always available at a hand sink in order to properly wash hands.   

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
In the storage closet to the left of the bar, the floor appears to be caving in badly. The ice machine is also stored inside of the closet. PIC noted that the floor can’t be repaired until the ice machine is removed from the room. PIC also noted that the ice machine is rented. There is a note placed on the ice machine that states that the company who owns the machine will be to pick it up April 8, 2024. Overall, the facility is aware that the floor is in need of repair and is currently working to get this issue resolved.

A referral has been made to Sangamon County Building and Zoning. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Employee reporting agreement were not available during the inspection. Employees had not signed agreements. All employees must sign employee health reporting agreements, and they must available for review during inspections. 

2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
The ice machine was observed soiled with mold and mildew. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned at a frequency that is is maintained clean to avoid contamination of ice from mold. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed the area on the bottom of the soda nozzle holder to be soiled. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation. The PIC stated the holder would be cleaned later tonight.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  Reference 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed pork reheating in a crock pot to be probed at 60F and a bag of pork in the reach in cooler in the back that was date marked 9/10. Pork is reported to have been cooked in a roaster here, cooled, frozen and then is pulled to be reheated. Facility is a medium risk facility and is not allowed to cook, cool and reheat. See General Comments that discusses doing these high risk tasks at their high risk facility down the street. Pork that was prepared on site may not be served to the public.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a bag of sliced ham in the reach in cooler that was date marked 11/3. Employee reports that this had been frozen at Bunkers and brought down here midweek last week. Make sure to date mark ready to eat, potentially hazardous foods with the date that you take them out of the freezer to thaw so that you ensure that these products are not held at refrigerated temperatures for over 7 days.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed a box of cups to be stored on the floor in the back prep area. Store single service items up and off of the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> 1) Observed pork in the cooler thawing. Pork had previously been cooked in crock pots and cooled at the facility, which is outside of their risk category. Pork should either be discarded or used for personal use only and not served to the public. Only commercially pre-cooked products may be cooked and served as a medium risk facility. 2) Facility is using raw sausage on the pizzas. Cease the use of raw sausage and hand forming of the sausage for pizzas and use pre-cooked, pre-formed sausage only as a medium risk facility. The raw sausage may be used for personal use only.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed bar to be cooking and preparing potentially hazardous foods in an apartment behind the bar that the owner's father lives in. Facility is also cooking, cooling, freezing and reheating potentially hazardous foods in this apartment and in crock pots in the bar to serve to the public. This is outside of the permit allowances for a LOW RISK facility. Cease cooking and serving of potentially hazardous foods immediately. Pork was discarded during inspection.  ***A Compliance Conference has been scheduled for Wednesday, February 10, 2016 at 9 AM. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
1) No thermometers observed in refrigeration units/freezers in the apartment. 2) No stem thermometer on site for checking internal product temperatures. Provide accurate and conspicuously placed thermometers in all refrigeration units. Provide a stem thermometer. 
750-230 A calibrate metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2F° shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed raw chicken wings stored above fully cooked spiral hams in the upright freezer in the apartment. All raw food should be stored below ready to eat/fully cooked foods.  
750-130(d)  All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Facility has chlorine test strips but is using Quaternary Ammonium sanitizing tablets without having test strips for quaternary ammonium. Provide proper sanitizing strips.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the soda gun nozzle near the Bud Light to be heavily soiled with mold and syrup accumulation. Wash, rinse and sanitize soda gun nozzle. 
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed pizza boxes and single service cups to be stored on the floor in the back storage room of the bar. Store single service items at least 6" off the floor. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the sink in the women's restroom to be slow draining. Repair plumbing so sink drains effectively. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
1) Observed no self closer on the women's restroom door. 2) Observed no covered waste can in the women's restroom. Provide a self closer to door and covered waste cans.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed all three doors to the bar to be open with screen doors in place which have gaps along the bottoms of all of the screen doors. Two of the interior doors seal well. The interior door nearest the dumpster has a gap at the bottom of the door as well. All outer openings should be sealed completely to prevent rodent entry. 
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > The ice machine has been moved from the back room to the main bar room. The ice machine drain line does not have a 1 inch air gap between the drain line and floor drain. The drain line is below the rim of the floor drain cup. Drain line was repaired so their is a one inch air gap.
750-290 Ice storage bins shall be drained through an air gap. Provide an air gap.
